verses.1: And God’s words became known to all of Israel. Israel went out to fight against the Philistines. They camped on Mount Ebal. The Philistines camped at Afek.
verses.2: And the Philistines prepared for battle against Israel. They attacked Israel in the field of Battle. Four thousand men were killed in this battle.
verses.3: And the people went to the camp. The elders of Israel said, “Why have You wronged us today, O LORD? The LORD took away from us the Ark of the Covenant. Now it will come into our midst and save us from our enemies.”
verses.4: And the people sent Shelah, and they brought back from there the chariots of the LORD’s army, those who sat on the wheels. And there were also two sons of Eli with those chariots of the LORD’s army: Pinchas and Abias.
verses.5: And when the army of Jehovah entered into the camp, all of Israel suffered a great disaster. The land became desolate.
verses.6: And the Philistines heard the sound of the crying. They said, “What is this loud cry among the Israelites?” They knew that Jehovah was coming to the camp.
verses.7: And the Philistines saw that God had said, “God will come to the camp.” They said, “Alas for us! It certainly wasn’t like this when Shelishma spoke.”
verses.8: Oh, who will save us from the hands of these mighty gods? These are the gods who destroyed Egypt in every way possible.
verses.9: They became stronger and became women who were unfaithful. Then they would serve the foreigners, just as they had served you before. And then you would become people who fought against each other.
verses.10: And the Philistines fought against Israel. They attacked Israel’s camps. Many people died from these attacks. Three hundred thousand Israelites were killed.
verses.11: And the Ark of God was taken away. And the two sons of Eliezer died: Haphni and Pinchas.
verses.12: And a man from Binnimun ran away from the camp. On that day, Shilo arrived there. His clothes were torn, and the ground was covered with blood on his head.
verses.13: And he came, and behold, there was a man sitting on the throne. His hands were stretched out in a gesture of fear, as if he were afraid of God’s judgment. The man came to speak in the city, and all the people cried out in fear.
verses.14: And Eli heard the sound of crying. He said, “What is this sound of wailing?” Then the man rushed over and reported to Eli.
verses.15: And he was born at the age of ninety-seven years. His eyes were open, but he couldn’t see anything.
verses.16: And the man said to his master, “I have come from the prison. I have been released from there today.” And he asked, “What will happen to me?”
verses.17: And the prophet said, “May God have mercy on Israel before the Philistines. There was also a great plague among the people. Your two sons died: Haphniy and Pinchas. And the Ark of God was taken away.”
verses.18: And it happened that, when he remembered God’s promises, he fell from the altar. Another person fell beside his hand. His clothes were torn apart. He died, just like any old man would die. And he judged Israel for forty years.
verses.19: And at that time, Rebekah’s sister heard the news of God’s plan. She was terrified, and she fell down. She gave birth to a son, because her situation had changed.
verses.20: And now she has died. The women who were with her spoke about her. Do not be afraid, for she was only a child. She did not eat or drink at all.
verses.21: And they called to the young man Eiy-Kavod, saying, “Go away from Israel. Take away the Ark of God and its utensils.”
verses.22: And Gala said, “Glory to Israel! For the Ark of God has been taken away.”
